provider: OpenRouter (https://openrouter.ai/api/v1), paid key with a credit limit
notes: Each model is pinned to one hosting provider with fallbacks off, so every run of a model is served by the same build (quantization is noted per model).
usage.include returns the provider-reported cost of each call; the harness charges it to the ledger, so --max-cost stops a run in dollars.
reasoning.enabled=false switches built-in reasoning off where the model has it; the harness's own reasoning stage is the compute knob.
